independent_cpu_formula.scope: 40 CPU FP64 formula/VJP tests across source_residual and all three incoming profiles, separate/fused and structural-deletion versus genuine-zero derivative cases
independent_cpu_formula.establishes: selected algebra, all input/parameter VJPs and structural-versus-real-zero domains at the tested CPU scope
independent_cpu_formula.does_not_establish: these integrated NPU trajectories, arbitrary NPU operators, or every later optimizer coordinate

cpu_decimal_adamw.scope: CPU FP32 compact-5-dd4 mixed n2 h1 d64 incoming_light_64 Settle; regional.4.second.bias coordinate 20
cpu_decimal_adamw.established: step-2 observed parameter delta 2.0191073417663574e-05 versus Decimal replay 2.0195122628671736e-05; error 4.0492110081613575e-09; step-3 error 4.097399267100066e-09
cpu_decimal_adamw.mechanism: small gradient differences can be amplified by AdamW epsilon/normalization and then retained in moments
cpu_decimal_adamw.limitation: the present NPU largest update failures often concern receive.q/k left or weight; no scalar replay of those NPU coordinates was performed, so the CPU witness cannot close their causal explanation

cpu_thread_repeat.scope: CPU FP32 incoming_light_128 Timed, 4-thread versus 1-thread bounded restore/repeated-VJP diagnosis
cpu_thread_repeat.established: same-owner repeated VJPs can differ without checkpoint loading; exact test thread scope was isolated in 7901ab75 while original failures were retained
cpu_thread_repeat.limitation: this is not proof of the mechanism behind the NPU embedding-gradient repeats

interpretations: Same-profile inference, grad-enabled forward, continued training and restored update are separate claims. A successful candidate-local restore does not erase cross-candidate divergence.
Fixed-start and inference equality do not require subsequent gradients, moments or optimizer trajectories to be bitwise equal.

FP32 attention auto permits gradient-dependent prior representations. This is a plausible site to inspect, but these records do not capture actual per-call dispatch, and no NPU root cause is asserted.
The optimized variant combines compatible region batching, fused QKV/static mask, and SSD doubling. Its differences are not attributable to any one component from this combined comparison.
First returned fields are deterministic lexicographic tree-order witnesses, not earliest execution or causal boundaries. Internal capture-limit records establish no internal first divergence.
Threshold-failure counts count tensor-field occurrences; repeated segments and forward/continued state can repeat related quantities. They are not counts of wrong nodes, scalars or independent bugs.
No new support, integer-time/index, dtype, None-connectivity or nonfinite difference in these records is a finite-scope observation, not a universal correctness proof.
